round_note: The Kaggle model (Daniel's no-border notebook, his W4A16 weights) is fine-tuned on the turns where it cleared a level in two of its own runs, then re-tested against itself.

panels.label: Held-out five
panels.note: Never trained. The stand-in for Kaggle's unseen games: the LoRA must not lose ground here.

panels.label: Train five
panels.note: Mid-range games with wins in the training data: where learning should show first.

panels.label: Hard four
panels.note: Almost never cleared past level 1 or 2, so a win here is obvious.

stages.label: Play
stages.detail: Daniel's notebook plays the games on our GPU box: 12 min to set up, 132 min of play

stages.label: Pick the wins
stages.detail: Keep the turns that cleared a level; cut each game into records of up to 120k tokens

stages.label: Train
stages.detail: LoRA on 4 RTX PRO 6000 cards, one record at a time

stages.label: Merge
stages.detail: Write the LoRA into the 14 weight files it touches (72 GB of his 181 GB)

stages.label: Package
stages.detail: A copy of his Kaggle inputs with the merged files swapped in

stages.label: Test
stages.detail: Same panels on base and LoRA side by side, 5-6 repeats per game

stages.label: Score
stages.detail: Levels per repeat, panel totals with their margin of error
